audit.method: Source-free static and metadata audit of copied code, result, README, and pre-existing provenance evidence.

access.parsed_material: Code, JSON result, README, and pre-existing provenance result/manifest files only

binding_limitations: The result does not contain the screen-code SHA-256 or seed/code/runtime seal; this independent receipt roots code and result together.
There is no frozen protocol, source lock, run log, or independent execution receipt in the package. Its canonical result seal proves self-integrity, not preregistration or execution authenticity.
pinned_panel_opened=false is emitted as a literal. Non-pinned identity is supported by the fixed constants, four hashes, and pre-existing auxiliary provenance, not by an access log.

formula_audit.implemented_assignment: Hungarian maximization of unweighted squared cosine between concatenated Up/Down neuron vectors.
formula_audit.reported_metric: Raw target-energy capture after a through-origin least-squares scalar.
formula_audit.material_blocker: The target-neuron energy factor is omitted from the Hungarian score. Therefore the selected permutation is not generally optimal for the reported raw-MSE capture, and the result is not a certified favorable upper bound.

regression_family.implemented: One through-origin scalar per matched neuron, shared across concatenated Up and Down.
missing_more_favorable_legal_options: Gate role in the shared SwiGLU neuron geometry
regression_family.consequence: The tested cell is dominated by broader aligned-template families, so failure is not a converse for them.

controls.construction: Independent zero-mean iid Gaussian arrays, scaled to each source array's global raw energy before final FP32 cast.
limitations: Source first moments are not matched
Per-neuron row-energy distributions are not matched
Final FP32 cast removes literal exact energy equality
Two controls provide no calibrated uncertainty bound

evaluation_scope.fit_assignment_and_score_coordinates: The same complete 4096 coordinates are used to select the permutation, fit alpha, and score residual SSE.
evaluation_scope.interpretation: This outcome-leaky in-sample construction is favorable for an opportunity screen but provides no held-out generalization evidence.

corroborating_context_not_used_to_cure_b.description: A pre-existing committed oracle reports the broader Gate/Up/Down, energy-objective, role-wise-scalar family across 30 pinned-panel pairs as a hard kill. It corroborates the negative direction but does not make this new package's assignment an upper bound.

verdict.reason: The 49.1x raw and 388.3x corrected gaps are persuasive prioritization evidence, but no full score/energy matrix or alternative bound is retained to limit the correctly weighted optimum, and the model family omits stronger legal role-wise/Gate variants.

seal.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=true, allow_nan=false, after removing seal.canonical_unsigned_sha256
